verdict.rationale: Cactus produces and runs its own low-bit models: the platform offers 2-bit exports, and a community benchmark ran a fine-tuned Needle 3 at W4A8 (4-bit weights). It can also convert arbitrary HuggingFace models, though that path is labelled experimental. Nothing in the evidence documents loading third-party quantized formats like FP8, GPTQ or AWQ. missing for 10: documented support for loading FP8/GPTQ/AWQ checkpoints, an explicit list of supported quantization formats, first-party INT4 loading docs, independent corroboration that externally quantized models load reliably.
